title: Denmark Faces Twin Pressures: Arctic Sovereignty Tests and Rising Borrowing… · 14 Sep
keywords: Denmark, Greenland, Arctic security, sovereignty, NATO, Danmarks Nationalbank, interest rates, inflation, cost of living, ECB, European Union, mortgage, defense spending, great-power competition, European strategic autonomy
notes: Denmark is navigating two converging crises that touch both national security and personal finances. A decision to deploy conscripts to Greenland has sharpened the country's Arctic posture amid intensifying great-power rivalry, while a central bank rate increase is tightening the financial grip on mortgage holders and renters. Together, the two developments illustrate how small open economies like Denmark are being pulled simultaneously by geopolitical forces and the broader European economic cycle.
